items.title: DevFest Aba 2026
items.text:
Date: 5 December 2026, 09:30 UTC
Ends: 5 December 2026, 15:00 UTC
Location: RAD5 Tech Hub, 181 Aba-Owerri Road
Registration: Free registration

Join us for DevFest Aba 2026, a dynamic gathering of tech enthusiasts and developers excited about Google's cutting-edge technologies. Dive into captivating sessions on the latest tools from Google, engage in interactive hands-on workshops, and network with peers who share your passion for innovation. Whether you're a novice or an expert, this event offers something for everyone. Don't miss out—register now and be part of a transformative experience that connects and empowers the tech community in Aba!
